primary_surfaces.OMEGA: persistent living projection of canonical state, active operators, relations, time, observations, forecast branches and available actions
primary_surfaces.CALCULUS: direct manipulation of C_Omega, Phi, q, Lambda, observer, phase, time, relation geometry, derivatives, integrals and trajectories
primary_surfaces.EARTH: source-backed geospatial and temporal observation with explicit derived-model and forecast boundaries
primary_surfaces.MEMORY: navigable continuity graph of events, scars, relationships, contradictions, recoveries, branches and retained context
primary_surfaces.INTELLIGENCE: route-before-generation conversation, mode orchestration, competing interpretations, forecast and action planning
primary_surfaces.CREATE_SIMULATE: bounded model construction, state-space exploration, trajectory simulation and representational rendering
primary_surfaces.SOVEREIGN: one canonical machine with cloud, PC and mobile acting as execution and observation locations rather than competing products
primary_surfaces.BUILD: governed recursive development, archive recovery, candidate comparison, tests, visual acceptance, promotion and rollback
primary_surfaces.PROOF: provenance, contradiction, admissibility, replay, evidence and release proof with progressive expert disclosure

support_visibility_rule: support systems must remain available for truth and expert control but may not dominate ordinary operation
mode_rule: all established modes remain distinct operators, gates, constraints, diagnostics or projections over one canonical packet; they may cooperate but may not collapse into generic blended semantics or fork independent state engines
representation_rule: 144, 1728, 20736 and larger shells are representational computational resolutions; shell changes must alter resolution, relation density, trajectory detail, aggregation or projection and are not physical-dimension claims
self_build_rule: self-development is candidate-only recursive improvement: observe -> diagnose -> recover -> prune -> compose -> test -> compare -> visually verify -> prove -> promote_or_reject -> observe_result -> update_strategy_memory
archive_rule: recover strongest verified capabilities from historical software without accumulating duplicate launchers, renderers, state authorities, dead experiments, obsolete menus or synthetic truth
acceptance_question: Does this change measurably improve OMEGA at observing, understanding, relating, calculating, remembering, anticipating, acting, visualizing or proving?
